final: SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_ram) AS avg_of_site_ram_usage, AVG(site_avg_ratio) AS avg_of_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM (SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, p.zoneref AS zoneref, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS site_avg_ram, AVG(p.procgpu * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS site_avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.entrystat, p.zoneref) AS per_site GROUP BY entrystat
